region.finding: Fresh source and battle close-face review confirms chin compression during alternate idle, hit and defeat. Independent muzzle and lower-jaw patches retain neck/chest weights. All 24 raw clip sheets inspected, including complete antlers and body. Candidate requires full geometry and repeated visual approval.

All raw source/battle clips inspected. Beak silhouette is mostly coherent, but independent lower-beak geometry finds small residual neck/chest influence in the source asset. Correct that residual binding and verify without claiming a large visible baseline collapse.

Fresh source/battle review confirms lower muzzle and chin collapse in attack/cast, compression in hit reactions and folding in defeat. Lower-face vertices retain chest, spine, arm and pelvis influences. Wings, feet and tail inspected separately in complete body views. First candidate reapplication strengthened the earlier neck blend and produced four whole-mesh warnings; rejected. Apply only the new front-jaw region to preserve the existing reviewed neck/wing bindings.
Broad lower lip/cheek and hood boundary compress during strike/recoil. All 13 original body and head clips inspected; lower mask includes complete mouth.
